name: TVD Holdings Public Company Limited
summary: TVD Holdings Public Company Limited and its subsidiaries specialize in the distribution of various products and services utilizing a diverse range of marketing avenues. The company's activities extend to producing and selling television programs and advertising airtime, alongside offering household goods and other merchandise. These are made available through numerous channels, including online platforms, satellite and cable TV, direct mail, mail order, outbound call centers, e-commerce, and dedicated customer service centers. Furthermore, TVD Holdings provides specialized services such as delivery logistics, data center solutions, life insurance brokerage, and the development of digital platforms. As of December 30, 2021, it operated 61 distribution facilities located in Bangkok and other provinces throughout Thailand. Founded in 1999, the company was formerly known as TV Direct Public Company Limited until its rebranding to TVD Holdings Public Company Limited in July 2022, with its headquarters situated in Bangkok, Thailand.
